summary: SNDL Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing the immediate resignation of director Carlo Cannell from its Board of Directors effective October 6, 2026. The filing consists solely of a press release; no replacement director, reason for departure, stake, price, premium, or advisor was disclosed, and the Board offered only a routine expression of thanks for his contributions. No transaction, strategic review, or compensation arrangement is referenced. Watch for any follow-on 6-K or proxy disclosure clarifying cause, board composition, and whether Cannell's exit signals investor disagreement or a broader governance shift.
